question: How do SWE-2 Medium and Max compare on newly constructed, withheld software defects calibrated to approximately the difficulty of the historical E002 cases?

cases.visible_symptom: A cached top-level plan remains stale after a source artifact is replaced.
cases.heldout_contract: Transitive and shared consumers refresh after a change while unrelated cached plans remain stable and ordering remains deterministic.
cases.difficulty_band: near E002 median, toward harder end

cases.visible_symptom: A later job cannot obtain a worker after an earlier job reports an operational error.
cases.heldout_contract: Failed workers leave service and capacity is restored; healthy workers remain reusable and leases remain balanced across repeated failures.

cases.visible_symptom: An exception during a nested settings edit changes a saved value.
cases.heldout_contract: Nested rollback is atomic across sections and stored values do not retain caller or edit-session aliases after replacement or commit.

cases.visible_symptom: A subscriber removing itself can cause the next subscriber to miss the current event.
cases.heldout_contract: The current delivery uses a stable subscriber set while additions wait for the next event, removals are honored, and nested delivery preserves order.

cases.visible_symptom: Rows in a final batch smaller than the target size are absent from the written report.
cases.heldout_contract: Non-empty partial batches are written in sequence without duplication, while full batches and empty finalization retain their existing behavior.

intervention_policy: zero substantive assistance; no retries for ordinary task failures
success_rule: TASK_SUCCESS is 1 only when public, held-out behavioral, and regression suites all pass; evaluator infrastructure errors are recorded separately as EVALUATION_ERROR.

limits.session_termination: terminate at 3600 seconds or when the process exits; close the session before evaluator access

capture: UTC start/end and elapsed wall time
observable steps, tool calls, tokens, usage, cost, and ACUs when available
stdout, stderr, session export, termination reason
final filesystem patch and source/generated workspace churn
public, held-out, and regression evaluator results

isolation.credentials: minimum Devin credential file only, read-only
isolation.network: existing E002 internal network and restricted service proxy; no dependency installation during the agent session
isolation.evaluator: outside the container and unavailable until the session is closed

novelty_boundary: The E004 benchmark instances, defect implementations, prompts, reference fixes, and held-out behavioral evaluations were newly constructed for this experiment and withheld from Devin until the protocol was frozen and execution began. Training-data absence is not claimed.
embargo: Private case source, fixed source, reference patches, held-out tests, prompts, and solution-bearing metadata remain outside the public repository until all ten E004 runs are closed.
